20261119-physics-g09.material: Masaafada ay qori la riixay waxaa la cabbiray marka gaadhi, oo leh cufnaan iyo xawaare kala duwan, uu ku dhaco. Gabagabada tamarta kinetic-ka ee sax ah waa mee?

20261121-physics-g09-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da (Isticmaal g = 9 si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261121-physics-g09-1.material: Roller coaster cufnaantiisu tahay 2 kg ayaa ka bilaabmay nasasho 20 m dhulka ka sarreeya waddo aan marayn. Waa imisa tamarta kinetic-ka daqiiqada uu gaadho dhulka? (Isticmaal g = 9.8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-g09-1.s.s1.prompt: Roller coaster cufnaantiisu tahay 2 kg ayaa ka bilaabmay nasasho 20 m dhulka ka sarreeya waddo aan marayn. Waa imisa tamarta kinetic-ka daqiiqada uu gaadho dhulka? (Isticmaal g = 9.8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-g09-1.s.s1.explain: Sharciga ilaalinta tamarta farsamada awgiis, dhammaan tamarta jagada ee yaraatay waxay isu rogaysaa tamar kinetic. $E_k = mgh = 2\text{ kg} \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2 \times 20\text{ m} = 392\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-g09-2.material: Haddii xawaaraha gaadhi ee waddada ku yaal uu labanlaabmo 50 km/h ilaa 100 km/h, masaafada joojinta ee simbiriirixa waxay ku kordhaysaa ilaa immisa jeer marka si xoog leh loo jebiyo?
20261121-physics-g09-2.thinking.0: Haddii xawaaraha gaadhi ee waddada ku yaal
20261121-physics-g09-2.s.s1.prompt: Haddii xawaaraha gaadhi ee waddada ku yaal uu labanlaabmo 50 km/h ilaa 100 km/h, masaafada joojinta ee simbiriirixa waxay ku kordhaysaa ilaa immisa jeer marka si xoog leh loo jebiyo?
20261121-physics-g09-2.s.s1.explain: Shaqada ay xoogga xoqitaanku sameeyo marka la dhexgalo masaafada joojinta $s$ waxay nuugtaa tamarta kinetic-ka, sidaas darteed $f \cdot s = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \implies s \propto v^2$. 20261118-physics-g10.title: Meel u dhow dhulka dusha
20261118-physics-g10.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Meel u dhow dhulka dusha si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261118-physics-g10.material: Meel u dhow dhulka dusha, laba kubadood oo bir ah A iyo B oo isku dherer ah, A waxaa laga sii daayay nasasho si xor ah u dhacdo, B-na waxaa si xoog leh jiif loogu tuuray. Weedhee ayaa dhaqdhaqaaqooda ku saabsan sax ah? (Iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada.)
20261118-physics-g10.s.s1.prompt: Meel u dhow dhulka dusha, laba kubadood oo bir ah A iyo B oo isku dherer ah, A waxaa laga sii daayay nasasho si xor ah u dhacdo, B-na waxaa si xoog leh jiif loogu tuuray. Weedhee ayaa dhaqdhaqaaqooda ku saabsan sax ah? (Iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada.)

20261119-physics-g10.title: mid dhul sibidh ah
20261119-physics-g10.goal: Codso mabaadi'da mid dhul sibidh ah si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261119-physics-g10.material: Laba ukun oo isku cufnaan ah ayaa laga dhigay isla dherer, mid dhul sibidh ah, midna barkin jilicsan. Isbarbardhigga cabbirrada fiisigiska ee saxda ah laga bilaabo daqiiqadda ukun kasta uu taabto dusha ilaa uu istaago waa kee?
20261119-physics-g10.s.s1.prompt: Laba ukun oo isku cufnaan ah ayaa laga dhigay isla dherer, mid dhul sibidh ah, midna barkin jilicsan. Isbarbardhigga cabbirrada fiisigiska ee saxda ah laga bilaabo daqiiqadda ukun kasta uu taabto dusha ilaa uu istaago waa kee?
20261119-physics-g10.s.s1.explain: Maadaama isbeddelka momentum-ka ($\Delta p$) labada ukun uu isku mid yahay, impulse-ka ($I = F\Delta t$) waa isku mid. 20261122-physics-g10-1.material: [Farsamada sare] Shay cufnaantiisu tahay 1 kg ayaa si jiif ah looga tuuray 20 m/s cidhifka dhagax 80 m dherer ah. Waa intee jiifka uu socdaa ka hor inta uusan gaadhin dhulka? (Isticmaal g = 10 m/s² oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada.)
20261122-physics-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: [Farsamada sare] Shay cufnaantiisu tahay 1 kg ayaa si jiif ah looga tuuray 20 m/s cidhifka dhagax 80 m dherer ah. Waa intee jiifka uu socdaa ka hor inta uusan gaadhin dhulka? (Isticmaal g = 10 m/s² oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada.)
